title: NexKeyRuntime update manifest
description: What the SDK's update handle fetches and evaluates: the newest release for one target, plus the notices that apply to it. Unsigned by design — it carries no secret and grants nothing, so nothing here needs to be trusted beyond the transport. Every limit below is enforced by the SDK's parser: a manifest that violates any of them is rejected whole, not partially applied.

schemaVersion.description: Only 1 is understood. A manifest declaring anything else is rejected rather than interpreted.

target.description: Which product this manifest describes. Must match what the SDK was configured with, or the manifest is rejected — this is what stops one product's manifest being served to another.

latestRelease.description: The newest release on this channel, or null when there is none. The SDK reports an update only when this version is strictly greater than the running one AND this channel equals the configured one — publishing a beta release under a stable key silently reaches nobody.

notices.description: At most ten, with unique ids. A duplicate id rejects the whole manifest.

enabled.description: false switches off update checks and notices for this target. Defaults to true.

checkAfterSeconds.description: How long the SDK waits before checking again. Defaults to 86400.

maxVisibleNotices.description: Reserved. The SDK presents one notice at a time today and does not act on this value.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must begin with a letter or digit.

locale.description: Alphanumeric segments joined by single hyphens, e.g. en or pt-BR.

opaqueId.description: Letters, digits, hyphen, underscore and dot only.

version.description: Semantic version, with an optional leading v.

timestamp.description: UTC, exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. No offsets, no fractional seconds — the SDK parses this shape and no other.

mcnexusHttpsUrl.description: Must begin with https://mcnexus.app/ — the SDK enforces this prefix and rejects anything else, including your own domain. See the note on self-hosting in docs/UPDATES_AND_NOTICES.md.

action.description: What the SDK opens when the user acts. It opens the deep link first and falls back to the https URL when MCNexus is not installed.

type.description: Only open_nexus exists. The SDK never downloads or installs anything itself.

deepLink.description: Must begin with mcnexus://updates/ or mcnexus://notices/. Any other scheme or path is rejected.

revision.description: Raise it to republish a corrected notice: a dismissal recorded against a lower revision no longer suppresses it, so the correction reaches people who dismissed the earlier wording.

type.description: Descriptive only. It does not change what the SDK selects or when — use it for your own presentation choices.

severity.description: This is what decides which notice is presented when several are eligible: the most severe wins, ties broken by the most recent startsAt.

expiresAt.description: Required. A notice is shown only while startsAt <= now < expiresAt — there is no such thing as a notice that never expires.

dismissible.description: Whether the user may dismiss it. The vendor decides, not the user.

remindAfterSeconds.description: How long a 'remind me later' hides it. Omit or set 0 to offer no snooze. Capped at 31 days.

audience.description: Who sees it. Every field is optional and each omitted one means 'everyone' — an absent audience reaches every user of this target. All of it is evaluated on the device; the host is never sent to the backend.

hostRules.description: Matched against the host name and version the product reports, verbatim. A rule written against a string no host actually reports matches nobody, silently.

content.description: The text, per language. The SDK picks the closest match to the configured locale and falls back to defaultLocale.

defaultLocale.description: Must be present as a key in locales, or the manifest is rejected.

locales.description: Keyed by locale tag. Every key is validated, so an unusable tag rejects the manifest rather than being skipped.
